comparison.objective: Remove a combustible spatula before placing a pan and energizing a burner; not commission an absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard recognition, utensil removal, pan placement, and knob actuation versus precision maintenance tooling and iterative mechanical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Combustible fully cleared before irreversible heat activation versus powered-off adjustment followed by two safe physical cycles and lock verification.
comparison.reason: Both enforce safe sequencing before activation, but that generic safety pattern does not make the physical abilities overlap. Heat is explicitly not simulated and no separate specs were present.
